video.title: Detroit Pistons Season Preview: A Step Forward For Ausar Thompson?

summary: Josh Lloyd and Coop (Locked On Pistons) preview the Detroit Pistons after a 60-win, number one seed season that ended in the second round. The roster changed: John Collins replaces Tobias Harris, Isaiah Stewart was traded, and Isaiah Joe was added. Jalen Duren's restricted free agency is stuck in a standoff. Coop expects him back on a deal somewhere around 35 to 45 million. The main fantasy story is Ausar Thompson. The team plans to give him more minutes and more time on the ball, and they expect him to take about three threes a game with a rebuilt jump shot. Josh says modest gains in shooting, usage, assists and minutes would make Ausar a top 50 player. Coop projects 50 to 51 wins and a third or fourth seed in the East.
